svg.title: Mother-Thread Ilvex, First Voice of the Sprawl

text.tspan: Mother-Thread Ilvex, First Voice of the Sprawl
Slow. Whenever you play another Biology
permanent, place a Growth counter on this
Mother-Thread Ilvex is the oldest voice The
Mireth Bloom still bothers to speak with, and
the Sprawl keeps expanding under her
regardless of what an opponent does to stop
